A silent horror film written and directed by Rui Teixeira as part of our Teen Filmmaking Bootcamp 2018. Cinematography by Rui and Jalen. Audio/Lighting by Jalen. Acting by Ven and Rodrigo. Edited by Rodrigo.

Find out more about SMC's Youth Media Programs at www.somervillemedia.org/youth-
